title: Targeting Yes-Associated Protein (YAP) in Breast Cancer: In Silico Molecular Dynamics, Luminescence-Based In Vitro, and In Vivo Validation of Rauvolfia tetraphylla-Derived Inhibitors.
authors: Balavaishnavi, B; Kamaraj, M; Nithya, T G; Sathish, Sruthy; Madhavan, Thirumurthy; Mahajan, Megha; Pandiaraj, Saravanan
journal: Luminescence : the journal of biological and chemical luminescence
one_liner_zh: 该研究针对YAP蛋白（非DNA互作）进行分子对接与MD模拟，核心是蛋白-小分子药物筛选，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: The study aims to elucidate the pharmacological mechanism of Rauvolfia tetraphylla against breast cancer through a comprehensive, multi-faceted approach. This includes molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and experimental validation. Initial screening via ADME analysis and network pharmacology identified key compounds and potential targets. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis pinpointed Yes-associated protein-1 (YAP) as a crucial target. Molecular docking revealed that three compounds-ajmaline, reserpine, and serpentine-exhibited strong binding affinities with YAP, with scores of -6.5 to -6.7 kcal/mol. Molecular dynamics simulations were conducted to assess the stability of these interactions further. Experimental validation showed R. tetraphylla inhibited breast cancer cell proliferation, with an IC50 of 348.69 mug/mL, while demonstrating cytoprotective effects on Vero cells (IC50: 1056.23 mug/mL). Migration assays indicated an 88.5% reduction in cell migration, and increased ROS levels signaled elevated stress in cancer cells. Apoptosis was confirmed by AO/EtBr staining. In vivo validation in a DMBA-induced mouse model confirmed significant tumor growth inhibition, supported by changes in YAP expression and histopathological analysis. These findings highlight R. tetraphylla as a promising therapeutic candidate against breast cancer, offering insights into its mechanisms and potential for future drug development and clinical applications.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过综合、多层面的方法阐明四叶萝芙木（Rauvolfia tetraphylla）对抗乳腺癌的药理机制，包括分子对接、分子动力学及实验验证。通过ADME分析和网络药理学初步筛选，确定了关键化合物和潜在靶点。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析将Yes相关蛋白-1（YAP）定位为关键靶点。分子对接显示，三种化合物——阿吗灵（ajmaline）、利血平（reserpine）和蛇根碱（serpentine）——与YAP表现出强结合亲和力，得分范围为-6.5至-6.7 kcal/mol。进一步进行了分子动力学模拟以评估这些相互作用的稳定性。实验验证表明，四叶萝芙木抑制乳腺癌细胞增殖，IC50为348.69 μg/mL，同时对Vero细胞显示出细胞保护作用（IC50：1056.23 μg/mL）。迁移实验显示细胞迁移减少88.5%，且ROS水平升高表明癌细胞应激增强。通过AO/EtBr染色确认了细胞凋亡。在DMBA诱导的小鼠模型中的体内验证证实了显著的肿瘤生长抑制，并得到YAP表达变化和组织病理学分析的支持。这些发现突显了四叶萝芙木作为对抗乳腺癌的有前景的治疗候选药物，为其机制及未来药物开发和临床应用潜力提供了见解。
